# Wyatt Brocato

> A PM testing AI on real work. Wyatt Brocato builds practical AI work systems for experienced professionals: rough inputs become work you can stand behind, with context, risk, and approval staying human.

This is the GitHub Pages host root for thewyattbrocato.github.io. It only indexes the project sites hosted under this host. The one main link for Wyatt Brocato is [wyattbrocato.site](https://wyattbrocato.site/), which has the Sunday letter: one practical AI workflow every week, with one workflow, one check, and one test.

## Main site

- [wyattbrocato.site](https://wyattbrocato.site/): the one link. The Sunday letter, five minutes to read, free.

## Project sites on this host

- [AI Deal Finder](https://thewyattbrocato.github.io/ai-deal-finder/): search store pages that were checked ahead of time. Each result shows the shelf price, a plain decision, and a coupon only when that product's own page printed one. It runs in the browser. Source: [ai-deal-finder repository](https://github.com/thewyattbrocato/ai-deal-finder).
- [Scam First Aid](https://thewyattbrocato.github.io/scamfirstaid-site/): free, private help after a scam, with ordered steps, exact words to say, and family conversation scripts. Nothing typed leaves the browser. The [public repository](https://github.com/thewyattbrocato/scamfirstaid-site) holds the reviewed static site, not the source.
- [Leverage Library](https://thewyattbrocato.github.io/leverage-library-site/): a sourced, cross-book idea library. Each idea is attributed, paraphrased, and flagged for confidence. The [public repository](https://github.com/thewyattbrocato/leverage-library-site) holds the reviewed static site, not the source.
- [AI Leverage Field Guide](https://thewyattbrocato.github.io/ai-leverage-field-guide-site/): interactive, role-based workflow guides with local progress tracking and explicit human-review boundaries. The [public repository](https://github.com/thewyattbrocato/ai-leverage-field-guide-site) holds the reviewed static site. As of 2026-10-22 the profile README links only the repository; this live page returned HTTP 200 when checked that day.
